title: I made a game with Godot Engine using Claude Code
author: artkoala
selftext:
**Playable Link:** [https://boil-egg.itch.io/fish-or-die-2](https://boil-egg.itch.io/fish-or-die-2)

**Platform:** Windows

I'm a creative writer who's never had an outlet to make games before. I tried for years and it felt so out of my depths. I recenly re united with my best friend who is a developer who uses AI. With his help I was able to make this game, an idea I've had for years that i'd only theorized.

I'm being fully honest about this project, it was a fully driven AI project. Every detail and design element was made solely in my own brain, and using the Opus 5.5 model via Claude Code I was able to make my concept a reality.

I'm a massive MMORPG gamer, i LOVE OSRS and WoW. Im also a huge fan of the game Rust, along with other intense survival games.

Feel free to try the game! Happy to answer any questions, and take any criticisms! 

**downloadable here on Itch.io!**  \--- > [https://boil-egg.itch.io/fish-or-die-2](https://boil-egg.itch.io/fish-or-die-2)

\-

*Fish or Die: Fishing Survival is an RPG single player game, where you must fish, to survive. Cook fish on the dock bbq, feed the island cat, meet the locals and earn reputation. Go see granny and check out her cosmetics, or visit the secret  CASINO on the island and double your gold!*

*Fishing rewards you in many ways, through fish you can make gold, find certain fish perfect for buffs! Sell your elusive fish to Pierre the Connoseur for profit!*

*Within this seemingly peaceful world, lies risk. Risk of natural disasters like lightning, the cold, and mainly hunger. So keep on top of your bbqing, take refuge in goldies shack if you finish his island quest!* 

  
Thank you for reading this far!
